content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Understanding Solana payments is crucial for digital creators who are locked out of mainstream platforms. Solana is a high-performance blockchain that facilitates fast and low-cost transactions, making it suitable for digital product sales. By leveraging Solana, you can bypass the fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. Instead, with NOWPayments, you incur only a 0.5% fee. This difference can mean substantial savings, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings and reinvest in their businesses.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for processing Solana payments involves several components working together seamlessly. At its core, you will utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, which automates order processing. When a transaction occurs, NOWPayments handles the crypto payment verification, ensuring it is confirmed on-chain. This infrastructure allows for instant product delivery, so once a payment is verified, the customer receives their digital product without delay. The result is an efficient, reliable system that empowers creators to operate independently.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators in countries where traditional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, using Solana payments allows you to access a broader audience while keeping your revenue intact. The system is particularly beneficial for those looking to build a sustainable online business without relying on platforms that charge high fees. It empowers creators to take ownership of their sales processes and financial transactions.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, a fraction of what traditional platforms demand.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your store, a simple backend logic layer via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. You can use services like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, ensuring that all data remains under your control. This stack is designed for simplicity and effectiveness, enabling creators to focus on their products rather than the complexities of payment processing.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for payment processing and configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Ensure that product delivery is automated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these components in place, you’ll have a fully operational digital store ready to accept Solana payments. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce infrastructure built on Solana payments. This system allows you to process payments in cryptocurrency, avoiding the high fees associated with conventional platforms. With NOWPayments, you can efficiently manage transactions while retaining more revenue from your sales.
Full ownership means you control your revenue and customer data.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options and build your infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your store. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment handling. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets to maintain full data ownership. Finally, configure automated digital product delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
